sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS We expect to receive net proceeds of approximately $3.98 billion from the sale of the notes to the underwriters, after deducting underwriting discounts and other estimated offering expenses payable by us. We intend to use the net proceeds from this offering to repay the 2027 Notes by their stated maturity and the remainder for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of outstanding borrowings under our commercial paper program, funding working capital and acquisitions. We may temporarily invest funds that are not immediately needed for these purposes in short-term investments, including marketable securities.
